input:
CURRENT SCENE:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

ITEMS:

[I0] 【孟子】小的时候   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟子: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧小的时候 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧出生以后 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子是孩子⟧ — her note: no logic relationship with the preceding or following sentences

[I1] 孟子和他的朋友喜欢【玩在墓地里】   correction: 玩在墓地里 → 在墓地里玩   strength: error
  checker's note: 在 + Place comes before the action: 在Place + V.
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: ⟦孟子从早到晚想玩玩儿，所以他和朋友坐墓地在祭拜⟧ — her note: loosely connected with the preceding sentence
  her past correction: 孟子一直跟他的朋友⟦去了⟧墓地祭拜 — her note: no了for routine/habit
  her past correction: 孟子老是想[玩玩→玩] — her note: V.V. is used to make requests or plans

[I2] 【装】祭拜   correction: 装 → 装作   strength: error
  checker's note: 装作 is needed before a verb phrase
  rule card (verb_object_valency, Grammar): Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <verb/verb phrase> must take <the allowed object or complement structure>; <brief reason, such as “it is a V.+Obj. compound” or “the action is durative, so use 着durative”>.  Her terms: 着durative, 跑遍 + place, 管事V.+Obj. compound, 掉 + directional + place, resultative complement
  her past correction: 在墓地[-做]祭拜
  her past correction: [+就]开始祭拜 — her note: 才 Num.就V.
  her past correction: 而是[-他]祭拜

[I3] 跟妈妈搬家【^】   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 所以妈妈跟孟子一起搬家[+了] — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [+就]跟孟母一起搬家三次 — her note: 才 Num.就V.
  her past correction: 孟母⟦老是⟧搬家 — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain

[I4] 而是【因为】妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近   correction: 因为 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧和他的妈妈住在离墓地很近 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: 孟子和他的妈妈住在离墓地很近[+的地方] — her note: 住在+Place
  her past correction: 他的妈妈[不想跟他的朋友去墓地→不想让他跟朋友去墓地] — her note: otherwise it means his mother didn’t want to go with his friend to the graveyard.

items.explanation: 孟子 appears for the first time, so please introduce him briefly with an identifying noun phrase, not only his name.
墓地 is the location, so use 在+Place before the action: 在墓地里玩.
装作 is needed before a verb phrase such as 祭拜. 装 alone cannot directly introduce this action.
It would be clearer to use 了 because the move is completed in the story: 搬家了.
It would be more natural to say 而是妈妈认为…… directly. 而是 already introduces the real reason, so 因为 is unnecessary here.
